lines.japanese: 「エ、うっそ。超バビんだけど。ね、なんでここ『けり』じゃなくて『ける』なん？　連体形で終わるとか、マジありえなくない？」
lines.english: “What? No way. That is, like, beyond shocking. Hey, why's this *keru* instead of *keri*? Ending in the attributive form? Like, is that even legal?”

lines.japanese: 「てゆかソレ、係助詞の『ける』だろ。だってほら、強調の『ぞ』付いてんじゃん。『ぞ』の結びは連体じゃん」
lines.english: “Uh, that's *keru* because of *kakari-musubi*. See the emphatic *zo* right there? *Zo* makes the verb end in the attributive form.”
“…Mmm…”

lines.japanese: 静かな廊下を歩いてくる賑やかな声が聞こえて、僕は浅い眠りから目覚めた──
lines.english: Boisterous voices came toward me down the quiet corridor, and I woke from a shallow sleep—

lines.japanese: ──目覚めた、という感覚を認識したとき初めて、自分が居眠りしていたことに気付いた。
lines.english: —or rather, only when I recognized the sensation of waking did I realize I had been asleep.

lines.japanese: なにか……なにか夢を見ていた気がする……。
lines.english: I felt as though I had been dreaming about something… something…

lines.japanese: まぶたを開けたけど、頭を起こす気力は湧いてこなかった。
lines.english: I opened my eyes, but could summon no will to lift my head.

lines.japanese: 僕は横倒しの世界を眺めながら、ひどく物憂いまどろみに浸かっていた。とてつもなく幸せな夢を見てしまったあとに決まって突きおとされる、あの虚脱感の淵の底にいた。
lines.english: I gazed at the world lying on its side, steeped in a miserable half-sleep. I was at the bottom of that hollow lassitude into which I always fell after an impossibly happy dream.

lines.japanese: ふと、目尻から頬にかけてのあたりに痒みを感じた。のっそり頭を上げて触れてみる。なにか液体が乾いたあとのような手触りがした。
lines.english: An itch stirred between the corner of my eye and my cheek. I sluggishly raised my head and touched it. The skin felt as though some liquid had dried there.

lines.japanese: どんな夢を見ていたかは思いだせない。
lines.english: I could not remember what I had dreamed.
“Mmm…”

lines.japanese: こわばっていた背中を伸ばして壁時計を見上げる。四時を過ぎていた。
lines.english: I stretched my stiff back and looked up at the clock. It was after four.

lines.japanese: 古文の復習に勤しむ女子の声が止まって、教室の後ろの扉が乱暴に開かれた。僕は怯えたウサギのように振りかえった。
lines.english: The girls reviewing classical Japanese fell silent, and the classroom's rear door flew open with a crash. I turned like a frightened rabbit.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　羽田いんじゃん」
lines.english: “Huh? Haneda's here.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、マジだー」
lines.english: “Oh, wow. He really is.”

lines.japanese: 高内さんだった。彼女に続いて、参考書を並んで覗くふたりも入ってくる。
lines.english: It was Takauchi. The two girls who had been poring over a study guide together followed her inside.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、こんなとこで何してんの」
lines.english: “What’re you doing in here?”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese: 僕が何か言葉を発するより先に、彼女が低い調子で詰めよってきた。
lines.english: Before I could produce another word, she bore down on me, her voice low.

lines.japanese: 悪びれていない目が、区画整理された机の合間を縫って迫ってくる。僕は彼女たちの方へ曲げっぱなしの首が痛かったから、逃げるように黒板の方を向いた。
lines.english: Her unabashed stare came at me through the neatly zoned avenues between the desks. My neck hurt from leaving it twisted toward them, so I escaped by turning back to the blackboard.

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃねーよ。何してんのかって聞いてんの」
lines.english: “Don’t ‘huh’ me. I asked what you’re doing here.”

lines.japanese: 高内さんが回りこむように僕の前へ立った。友人ふたりは教室のうしろで参考書を開き、係り結びについての知識を譲りあっている。前後を挟撃されてるみたいで、背筋が自然と張りつめた。
lines.english: Takauchi circled around to stand in front of me. Behind me, her two friends opened their study guide and traded what they knew about the rules for those classical verb endings. Caught between forces front and rear, I felt my spine stiffen of its own accord.

lines.japanese: 「え、だって……卒文制作の打ち合わせって……」
lines.english: “But… I thought we were meeting to discuss the graduation anthology…”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ。２時に図書室集合って言ったじゃん」
lines.english: “Yeah. I said to meet in the library at two.”

lines.japanese: 「図書室！？」
lines.english: “The library?!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ、それ。ちょっと待って、聞いてないよそれは」
lines.english: “What? Hold on. You never told me that.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ？　なんでよ、言ったっつうの。ねえ！　言ったよねえ！」
lines.english: “Excuse me? What’re you talking about? I totally did. Hey! I told him, didn’t I?”

lines.japanese: 「えー？　なにー？」
lines.english: “Huh? What?”

lines.japanese: 高内さんはわざわざ僕の後ろの女子たちに問いかけたけど、そのわり答えにはあまり興味がなかったみたいで返事を待たなかった。
lines.english: Takauchi went out of her way to ask the girls behind me, but she did not seem especially interested in their answer: she did not wait for one.

lines.japanese: 「とにかく私は言ったし。聞いてなかったんなら、それはそっちの責任」
lines.english: “Anyway, I told you. If you weren’t listening, that’s your problem.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おかしいよ、そんなはずは……」
lines.english: “No, that doesn’t make sense. There’s no way…”

lines.japanese: 僕は記憶を辿りながら控訴した。ちり、と細かな刺激が喉の奥を突いた。
lines.english: I searched my memory as I lodged my appeal. A fine, prickling irritation touched the back of my throat.

lines.japanese: たしかにあのときは、見られたくないひとに見られたくないところを見られていたせいで、ちょっとばかり混乱していたのは事実だ。でも、たぶん、おそらく……図書室なんて言葉は出てきていない。
lines.english: It was true that I had been a little confused at the time, since someone I did not want watching had seen something I did not want seen. But probably—almost certainly—no one had said a word about the library.

lines.japanese: 「うん。やっぱり違うよ。高内さん言ってない──」
lines.english: “Right. I knew it. You never said anything about—”

lines.japanese: 「ああーッ！」
lines.english: “Aaaagh!”

lines.japanese: とつぜん彼女が甲高い声を張りあげた。
lines.english: Without warning, she let out a shrill yell.

lines.japanese: 「っけんなよ！　オメ寝てたろ！」
lines.english: “Don’t screw with me! You were asleep!”

lines.japanese: ぴっ。森ゴブリンが好む毒槍の穂先みたいな爪が、僕の鼻先へ鋭く突きつけられた。
lines.english: Her nail—like the poisoned spearhead favored by forest goblins—snapped up to within an inch of my nose.

lines.japanese: 「え……ああ、ちょっとだけ……」
lines.english: “Uh… yeah. Just for a minute…”

lines.japanese: 頬か口元にうたた寝の痕跡でも残ってたんだろうか。僕は顔をこすりながら答える。口の中が砂を噛んだみたいにざらざらした。
lines.english: Had my nap left some telltale mark on my cheek or around my mouth? I rubbed my face as I answered. The inside of my mouth felt as gritty as though I had been chewing sand.

lines.japanese: 「んーだよオメ、要するに、爆睡かましてて来なかっただけじゃん！」
lines.english: “So that’s it! You passed out cold and never even showed!”

lines.japanese: 「うーわ！　やっべ私マジ、超キレ寸。ちょ、おまえさぁ？　パチこいて素でひとのせいにするとか、マジありえなくね？」
lines.english: “Oh my God! I am seriously one second from snapping. The hell, Haneda? You lie your ass off, then act innocent and blame somebody else? Is that even real?”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ……そうじゃなくて、おれはずっと待ってて……」
lines.english: “That’s not it… I was waiting here the whole time…”

lines.japanese: 冷たい風が吹きつけた。寒さに負けないよう、僕はこぶしを握った。
lines.english: A cold wind struck me. I clenched my fists against it.

lines.japanese: 喉が痛い。心臓がうるさい。目にごみが入ってまばたきが多くなる。
lines.english: My throat hurt. My heart clamored. Grit got in my eyes, and I blinked again and again.

lines.japanese: 「チャコまだぁー？　はやくワック行こーよー」
lines.english: “Chako, are you done yet? Come on, let's go to Wac.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー、もーいいじゃん。委員長反省してんだし、そんぐらいで許したりってー」
lines.english: “Yeah, come on, let it go. Class Rep's sorry, so cut him some slack.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？　ちょ、待てよ。おかしくね？　なんで私が責められてんの？」
lines.english: “What? Wait a second. How’d I end up being the bad guy here?”

lines.japanese: 「分かった分かった、あんたが正しいのはよく分かったから」
lines.english: “We get it, we get it. You’re right. We all know you’re right.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、委員長もさー、さっさと謝っちゃいなよ。実際、悪りぃことしたのは確かなんだしー」
lines.english: “Come on, Class Rep, just hurry up and apologize. You did mess up, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんでおれが──」
lines.english: “What? Why should I—”

lines.japanese: 「反論してんじゃねえよ、反省の色なしかてめえ！　いいからまず謝れよ」
lines.english: “Quit arguing! Not even sorry, are you? Just apologize already!”

lines.japanese: 「なんで──」
lines.english: “But why—”

lines.japanese: 「なんでじゃなくてゴメンだろー、ったりいな羽田ー」
lines.english: “Not why. Sorry. God, Haneda, you're such a pain.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、委員長はやくー」
lines.english: “Come on, Class Rep. Hurry up.”

lines.japanese: 強い風が下手くそな口笛みたいにびゅうびゅう鳴いている。目に砂が入って開けてられない。
lines.english: A hard wind howled around me like a poor attempt at whistling. Sand stung my eyes until I could no longer hold them open.
“…Sor—”

lines.japanese: もういい。もうなんでもいいから、とにかくこの痛みから逃れたかった。
lines.english: Enough. Anything would do now. I only wanted to escape the pain.

lines.japanese: 「……ごめん」
lines.english: “…Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 僕は吹きすさぶ砂塵に負けてこうべを垂らした。これは本当にひどい風だ。
lines.english: Defeated by the driving sand, I bowed my head. It truly was a terrible wind.

lines.japanese: 「はん！　じゃあコレ」
lines.english: “Hmph! Here, then.”

lines.japanese: 高内さんは仏頂面で鞄からルーズリーフを取りだした。一枚抜きとって、僕の机に叩きつける。
lines.english: Scowling, Takauchi pulled a sheaf of loose-leaf paper from her bag. She took out one sheet and slapped it onto my desk.

lines.japanese: 「あんた来ないから、こっちで分担決めさせてもらったわ。こんな感じでよろしく」
lines.english: “Since you didn't show, we went ahead and divided up the work. This is how we're doing it. Thanks in advance.”

lines.japanese: 「こふっ……かは、こふっ……」
lines.english: “Kh… cough, cough…”

lines.japanese: 異物感に喉が痛んで、頷きながら咳をした。彼女には、僕が従順に頭を下げたみたく見えたかもしれない。
lines.english: My throat hurt as though something were caught in it; I coughed as I nodded. To her, perhaps, it looked as though I were meekly bowing my head.

lines.japanese: 僕はそれを手前に引きよせ、砂埃の舞う中で辛うじて片目を開けた。Ｂ５サイズの白い紙面に、シャーペンの丸文字が伸び伸びと散らばっていた。
lines.english: I drew the page toward me and, amid the swirling grit, managed to open one eye. Rounded mechanical-pencil characters sprawled freely across the white B5 sheet.

lines.japanese: そこに記されている情報量はそう多くなかった。目を通した瞬間、僕は一時間目のテストに出てきた南京条約や日米修好通商条約を連想させられた。
lines.english: There was not much information on it. The moment I read it, I thought of the Treaty of Nanking and the Treaty of Amity and Commerce from our first-period exam.
“What…?”

lines.japanese: 僕は自分の首に手をかけて、なんとか咳を抑えようとした。
lines.english: I clutched my throat and tried somehow to suppress the coughing.

lines.japanese: そこに記されていたのは、今朝、彼女が一方的に提案した内容そのものだった。つまりはひどく片務的で、実質すべての作業が僕ひとりに委ねられていた。
lines.english: Written there was precisely the proposal she had made unilaterally that morning. It was grotesquely one-sided: in practice, every scrap of work had been entrusted to me alone.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……ちょっと、待って……ずるいよ、これは……」
lines.english: “Wait… Just wait. This isn’t fair…”

lines.japanese: 喉を絞りながら訴える。僕はこんな紙切れを押しつけられるために、渡来さんのいない教室でひとり何時間も待たされていたわけじゃない。
lines.english: I forced the protest through my constricted throat. I had not spent hours alone in a classroom without Watarai only to have this scrap of paper thrust upon me.

lines.japanese: なのに、ざらついた風とひどい咳の発作に見舞われて言葉が出てこない。
lines.english: Yet the rasping wind and a violent fit of coughing robbed me of words.

lines.japanese: なんとか目で訴えかけようとしたけど痛みで目蓋がろくに開かないし、どのみち彼女はもう背中を向けて歩きだしていた。
lines.english: I tried to plead with my eyes, but the pain would hardly let me open them. In any case, she had already turned her back and started away.

lines.japanese: じわりと重苦しい感覚が背筋を這いのぼってきた。頭が質量を増したかのごとく前へ傾いてゆく。吹きみだれる灰色の砂塵はいよいよ猛威を振るい、世界中の色彩を奪っていくようだった。
lines.english: A leaden sensation crept up my spine. My head bowed forward as though it had gained mass. The storm of gray dust raged ever more fiercely, seeming to leach every color from the world.

lines.japanese: 僕は噎せかえりながら頭を振った。口を塞ぎ、残った手で顔にかかる砂埃を払う。空気が汚い。息が詰まる。たぶんここはグロリアスが濃すぎるんだ。
lines.english: Choking, I shook my head. One hand covered my mouth while the other swept the dust from my face. The air was foul. I could not breathe. The Glorious must have been too dense here.

lines.japanese: まとわりつく微細な粒子を払いのけながら、僕は僕から遠ざかってゆくセーラー服の背中たちをわずかに開いた瞳で捕えた。
lines.english: As I brushed away the fine particles clinging to me, my narrowed eyes caught the backs of the girls in sailor uniforms receding from me.

lines.japanese: 誰だろう。知らない女のひとたちだ。何の話をしているんだろう。どうして平気で呼吸できるんだろう。どうしてあんなに笑っていられるんだろう。
lines.english: Who were they? Women I did not know. What were they talking about? How could they breathe as if nothing were wrong? How could they go on laughing like that?

lines.japanese: 「あーも、さっさと謝ってくんねーからこっちが悪役みてーじゃんなー？」
lines.english: “God, if he'd just apologized sooner, he wouldn't have made us look like the bad guys, right?”

lines.japanese: 「委員長、涙目ンなってたね。きゃはは、かあいそー」
lines.english: “Class Rep was nearly crying. Ahaha. Poor baby.”

lines.japanese: 「なー、こいつ鬼だよな。マチャコおまえ知んねーぞ、あーゆーのはある日突然プツッといくかんな。そんときゃ犯されたって文句言うなよ」
lines.english: “Seriously, that girl's a monster. Machako, don't say nobody warned you. Guys like that just snap one day. When he does, don't come crying that he raped you.”

lines.japanese: 「うええ、きもっ！　ムリだって、濡れねっつーの。童貞×んぽマジ勘弁。つかアレ、ぜってー包茎だろ」
lines.english: “Eww, gross! No way. I’d be dry as a desert. Spare me the virgin dick. Bet you anything he’s uncircumcised, too.”

lines.japanese: 「優しく剥いてあげればいいと思うよ」
lines.english: “You could always peel it back for him gently.”

lines.japanese: 「真性だったら剥くことすらできねーけどな」
lines.english: “Not if he’s got full-on phimosis.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、でもさ、自分で言うのもアレだけどさ。あいつ明日香さま一筋で、どうせうちらみたいの、性の対象になってねーって。犯すぐらいならむしろ刺しに来んだろ」
lines.english: “Yeah, but listen—and I know how this sounds coming from me. That guy only has eyes for Lady Asuka. Girls like us probably don’t even turn him on. He’d sooner come stab us than rape us.”

lines.japanese: 「それもどーかなあ。なんか自己陶酔型っぽいし。攻撃衝動、外に向かうより内に行きそうじゃない？」
lines.english: “I dunno. He seems like the self-absorbed type. Wouldn't he turn all that aggression inward instead?”

lines.japanese: 「したら、やっべ、屋上からコードレスバンジー？」
lines.english: “Then—holy crap—cordless bungee jumping off the roof?”

lines.japanese: 「ないない、それはない。あいつ、アタマだけはいいもん。ああいうのはさー、バカのやることだから──」
lines.english: “No, no. That won't happen. Whatever else he is, the guy's smart. That's the sort of thing idiots do—”

lines.japanese: ──風がやんだ。
lines.english: —The wind died.

lines.japanese: ピィ────、ヒョロロロロ……
lines.english: Peeeeee—wheeree-ree-ree…

lines.japanese: 清冽な笛の吹鳴が、色と音を失った世界にすうっと沁みわたった。
lines.english: A pure, piercing whistle seeped through the world that had lost all color and sound.

lines.japanese: 柳木原の空とは繋がっていないはるか彼方の地で、誰からも弾かれた僕を呼ぶ声があった。
lines.english: In a distant land unconnected to the sky over Yanagihara, a voice was calling to me—to the boy everyone here had cast out.

lines.japanese: ピィ────、ヒョロロロロ……
lines.english: Peeeeee—wheeree-ree-ree…

lines.japanese: 孤独な立方体を埋めつくす砂塵の中、きらりと一粒ほのかな輝きが生まれた。
lines.english: Amid the dust filling my solitary cube, one faint glimmer sprang into being.

lines.japanese: きらり、きらり、きらきらり……
lines.english: A glimmer, another glimmer, a glittering gleam…

lines.japanese: きらきら、きらきら、きらきらきら……
lines.english: Glittering, glittering, glittering on…

lines.japanese: かすかなきらめきは次々と連鎖し、みるみるその勢力を増やしてゆく。まるで砂金の粉雪だ。
lines.english: One faint sparkle kindled the next in a gathering chain, multiplying before my eyes. A snowfall of powdered gold.

lines.japanese: 濁った砂塵を駆逐して、輝く粒子が世界を金色に染めてゆく──
lines.english: The shining motes drove out the murky dust and dyed the world in gold—

lines.japanese: ──輝く粒子！
lines.english: —shining motes!

lines.japanese: そうだ、違う。これは砂埃なんかじゃない。
lines.english: Of course. I was wrong. This was no common dust.

lines.japanese: これはグロリアス・マテリアル。グレタガルドの召喚術士が、次元の壁を溶かす折、世界の狭間に散布する金色の触媒。
lines.english: This was Glorious Material: the golden catalyst a summoner of Gretagard scattered between worlds when melting through the walls between dimensions.

lines.japanese: なあんだ、そうだったのかあ。
lines.english: Oh. So that was all.

lines.japanese: ピィ────、ヒョロロロロ……
lines.english: Peeeeee—wheeree-ree-ree…

lines.japanese: 呼んでいる。
lines.english: It was calling me.

lines.japanese: ここではないどこかで、鳶の声を模した笛の音が僕を呼んでいる。
lines.english: Somewhere beyond this place, a whistle imitating the cry of a black kite was calling me.

lines.japanese: 僕は行かなくてはならない。
lines.english: I had to go.

lines.japanese: 僕を必要としているひとびとは向こうにいる。
lines.english: The people who needed me were waiting on the other side.

lines.japanese: 「向こうに……行かねば……」
lines.english: “I must… go to them…”

lines.japanese: 口に当てがっていた腕をそっと下ろし、濃密な光の粒を受けいれて深く息を吸いこんだ。
lines.english: I gently lowered the arm across my mouth, welcomed the dense motes of light, and drew a deep breath.

lines.japanese: グロリアスが喉に流れこんできて呼吸が苦しかったけれど、僕はその先に訪れる跳躍のときを待って目蓋を閉じた。金色の触媒がひそやかに次元の壁を侵蝕していた。
lines.english: Glorious poured down my throat and made breathing painful, but I closed my eyes and waited for the leap beyond. The golden catalyst was quietly eating through the wall between dimensions.

lines.japanese: 意識が白く霞んでゆき、やがて額に鈍い痛みと衝撃が走った。筋力の支えを失った僕の頭が、机の上に着地したんだろう。
lines.english: Consciousness faded into white. Presently a dull pain and jolt ran through my forehead. My head, robbed of all muscular support, must have landed on the desk.

lines.japanese: ピィ────、ヒョロロロロ……
lines.english: Peeeeee—wheeree-ree-ree…

lines.japanese: 呼んでいる。呼んでくれている。
lines.english: It was calling. Calling for me.

lines.japanese: 僕はひとりじゃない。僕は寂しくなんかない。
lines.english: I was not alone. I was not lonely.

lines.japanese: 僕は──
lines.english: I—

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、終わった？」
lines.english: “Haneda? Are you finished?”
“…What…?”

lines.japanese: 声が……した……。
lines.english: A voice… I heard a voice…

lines.japanese: 発ちはじめた港に……誰かやって来たみたいだ……誰だろう、困ったな……。
lines.english: Someone seemed to have arrived at the harbor just as I was setting sail... Who could it be? How troublesome...

lines.japanese: 近付いてくるおぼろな人影に……僕は薄らぎかけている視覚と意識を傾けてみた……。
lines.english: I turned my failing sight and fading consciousness toward the hazy figure drawing near…

lines.japanese: 「あ、ごめんね。びっくりした？」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. Did I startle you?”

lines.japanese: 誰だろう……よく見えない……よく分からない……。
lines.english: Who was it…? I could not see clearly… I could not tell…

lines.japanese: 「うん。実は私、隣りの教室にいたの。Ｂ組に志望校同じ子がいて、一問一答で腕試ししよーぜーって言うから丁度いいやと思って」
lines.english: “Yeah. Actually, I was in the classroom next door. There's a girl in Class B applying to the same school, and she said we ought to quiz each other and see what we could do, so the timing seemed perfect.”

lines.japanese: でも……覚えがある……この胸に沁みる声……泣きたくなるような優しさ……。
lines.english: But… it was familiar… that voice sinking into my heart… that kindness that made me want to weep…

lines.japanese: 「何度か覗きに来たんだけどね。羽田君、そのたびメール打ったり仮眠取ったりしてるから、声かけられなくて」
lines.english: “I came by to check on you a few times. But every time I did, you were either writing an email or taking a nap, so I didn’t want to bother you.”

lines.japanese: 「や、でも、高内ホント遅刻ひどいよね。あの子はちょっと時間に……うん、いいや。歩きながら話そっか」
lines.english: “But Takauchi’s really bad about being late, huh? She’s kind of… when it comes to time… Ah, never mind. Let’s talk while we walk.”

lines.japanese: 「帰ろ？」
lines.english: “Want to go home?”

lines.japanese: ああ……そうか……。
lines.english: Ah… Of course…

lines.japanese: 分かった……分かったぞ……。
lines.english: I understood… I understood now…

lines.japanese: 間違いない……この神々しいまでにあたたかい慈愛の意思は、きっとグレタガルドの……。
lines.english: There could be no mistake... This divinely warm will, overflowing with benevolence, must belong to Gretagard's...

lines.japanese: 「……プリンセス・ダヴ」
lines.english: “…Princess Dove.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「姫様……何故あなた程の方が、このような場所に……」
lines.english: “Your Highness… What brings one such as you to a place like this…?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　えっ！？」
lines.english: “Huh? What?!”

lines.japanese: 「宮殿にお戻りください……ここは風が穢れています……グロリアスが濃すぎるのです……」
lines.english: “Please return to the palace... The wind here is tainted... The Glorious is too dense...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君？　なに？　どうしたの？」
lines.english: “Haneda? What is it? What’s wrong?”
“…What…? Wait…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ……そうだ、分かった、渡来さんだ……」
lines.english: “Ah… right. I understand. You’re Watarai…”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの、こんなところで……はやく逃げた方がいいよ……ここはグロリアスが濃すぎるから、息苦しいでしょ……」
lines.english: “What are you doing in a place like this...? You should flee while you can... The Glorious is too dense here. You can hardly breathe, can you...?”

lines.japanese: 「はねだ、くん……？」
lines.english: “Haneda…?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……僕は行かなくちゃ……僕より可愛そうなひとたちが僕を呼んでるんだ……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry... I have to go... People less fortunate than I am are calling me...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君？　大丈夫？　顔真っ白だよ！？」
lines.english: “Haneda? Are you all right? Your face is completely white!”

lines.japanese: 「だって……さっき、夢を見たんだ……」
lines.english: “Because… I had a dream just now…”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんとゲームを選んでる夢……彼女はとても楽しそうで……でもいくら僕が説明しても、ロープレとＲＰＧが同じだってことを分かってくれないんだ……」
lines.english: “A dream where Watarai and I were choosing a game… She looked so happy… But however many times I explained, she just wouldn’t understand that a role-playing game and an RPG meant the same thing…”

lines.japanese: 「そんな僕らを見て……森里君が冷やかすみたいにニコニコ笑ってた……Ｈ組のみんなと一緒に……森里君は明るくて、本当は頭もいいから、みんなに好かれてて……」
lines.english: “Morisato watched us… smiling like he was teasing us… with everyone from Class H… He’s so cheerful, and actually really smart, so everyone likes him…”

lines.japanese: 「だから僕らは、いつもいい子にしてる小鳩に御影クリヤの新曲を買ってあげて……あの子も、おにいちゃんありがとうって笑ってくれて……」
lines.english: “So we bought Mikage Clear's new song for Kobato, because she was always such a good girl... and she smiled and said, ‘Thank you, Big Brother’...”

lines.japanese: 「山科さんは、ふた又のイヤホンを恋人とひとつずつ分けあって……ちょっと照れくさそうに、ずっと一緒に聴いてようねって笑ってて……」
lines.english: “Yamashina and her boyfriend shared a pair of wired earphones, one earpiece each… and she smiled a little shyly and said, ‘Let's listen together forever’…”

lines.japanese: 「それから針生さんが水を一口飲んで、その歌を驚くぐらい上手に歌いはじめたら……高内さんたちが超うめーって、手を叩いて喜んで……高内さんの友達も、みんなで嬉しそうに仲良く体を揺らして……」
lines.english: “Then Hariu took one sip of water and began singing the song so beautifully it startled us... Takauchi and the others clapped and cried, ‘You're so good!’... and all her friends happily swayed together...”

lines.japanese: 「みんな笑ってるんだ……みんな輪になって、その真ん中に僕がいて……誰も傷付かない、ひたすら安らかな時間を笑いさざめきながら過ごしているんだ……」
lines.english: “Everyone is smiling... Everyone forms a circle, with me at the center... Nobody gets hurt. We pass the time in perfect peace, laughing together...”
“Haneda…?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、こっちの世界は息苦しい……ちょっと……ちょっとだけ、行ってくるね……」
lines.english: “Ah, it is so hard to breathe in this world... I'm just... I'm just going over there for a little while...”

lines.japanese: 「行くって、どこに」
lines.english: “Going where?”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルドだよ……早く行かなくちゃ……ツヴァイ城砦のみんなが、聖騎士ホーク・シアンブルーの降臨を待っているんだ……」
lines.english: “To Gretagard… I have to hurry… Everyone at Zwei Fortress awaits the advent of Holy Knight Hawk Cyan-Blue…”

lines.japanese: 「危険因子とみなされたガルーダは封印されてるし……イーグルとファルコンはまだ行方が掴めてないから……みんなが僕を待っているんだ……」
lines.english: “Garuda was deemed a dangerous element and sealed away... and no one has found Eagle or Falcon yet... So everyone is waiting for me...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君。羽田君、聞こえる？」
lines.english: “Haneda. Haneda, can you hear me?”

lines.japanese: 「ね。それはどこにあるの？　どんなひとがいるの？　君はいつ戻ってくるの？」
lines.english: “Where is it? What sort of people live there? When will you come back?”

lines.japanese: 「すぐ、戻ってくるよ……召喚魔法が終わればこのあたりのグロリアスは薄くなるから……」
lines.english: “I’ll be back soon… Once the summoning spell ends, the Glorious around here will thin out again…”

lines.japanese: 「向こうとこっちは時間軸も違うし……すぐだよ……残念なぐらい、すぐに戻って……」
lines.english: “Time flows differently there and here... It won't be long... I'll be back almost disappointingly soon...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうか……」
lines.english: “Ah. I see…”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ……そうなんだね豆パン君……君は向こうで暮らすことを選んだんだね……」
lines.english: “Yes… I understand now, Mamepan… You chose to live over there…”

lines.japanese: 「でも……駄目だよそれは……」
lines.english: “But… you mustn’t…”

lines.japanese: 「だって……僕たちには……」
lines.english: “Because we…”

lines.japanese: 「僕たちには翼がないんだ……」
lines.english: “We have no wings...”

lines.japanese: 「……すごい」
lines.english: “…Wow.”
“Did you see that…?”

lines.japanese: 「すごいよね……」
lines.english: “Amazing…”

lines.japanese: 「どうしよう、本物だ……」
lines.english: “What do we do? He's the real thing...”

lines.japanese: 「この子、本物だ！」
lines.english: “This boy is the real thing!”
